body_html:
Atlanta’s Master of Memorable Moments

With a career that kicked off in 2002, Kofi I, better known as DJ Anikan, is a powerhouse of energy and talent who knows how to light up any event. Born and raised in Atlanta, GA, DJ Anikan brings a Southern charm and an electric vibe that has made him a favorite for over two decades. Hosting events since 2001, his versatile experience spans talent shows, step shows, fashion shows, award ceremonies, and karaoke—proof that he’s no stranger to commanding a crowd.

DJ Anikan’s love for music blossomed in the 90s, and his ability to read a room and create unforgettable moments has been his signature ever since. He describes DJing as “manipulating the soundtrack of life,” crafting memories through beats and rhythm. With a playlist that spans Redman, Big Boi, Afro Beats, Jazz, and Hip Hop, his diverse taste appeals to crowds of all kinds.

What’s in the Mix?
DJ Anikan’s setlist is legendary, with crowd-pleasers like “OMG” by Usher, “Don’t Stop Believing” by Journey, “This Is How We Do It” by Montell Jordan, “Party In The USA” by Miley Cyrus, and “Swag Surfin.” Whether it’s a corporate gala, school dance, pep rally, or brunch party, he has the perfect track to keep the dance floor alive.

Fun Facts:

  • DJ Anikan boasts a six-year residency on Washington DC’s Spirit of Washington, where he was awarded 2019 DJ of the Year.
  • He’s a go-to entertainer for student voyages, adding a personal touch to every experience.
  • As a student at the SAE Institute in Atlanta, he’s always evolving his craft.

Beyond the Decks
Married with three kids, DJ Anikan is a family man who loves acting, cartoons, pool, bowling, and catching live music. His vibrant personality and engaging energy make him a hit not just on stage but in every interaction.

If you’re looking for a DJ who can bring a blend of professionalism, fun, and unforgettable vibes, DJ Anikan is the one to call. Let him turn your event into a lasting memory!
